name: cf-uart
description: Configurable UART controller from ChipFoundry. Features: 5-9 data bits, even/odd/stick/no parity, 1-2 stop bits, line-break detection, configurable RX timeout, RX glitch filter, data-match detection, 16-byte TX/RX FIFOs with programmable thresholds, 16-bit baud prescaler, 10 IRQ sources, loopback for test. APB / AHB-Lite / Wishbone wrappers provided.

interfaces.description: System clock for bare core CF_UART (wrappers map to clk_i/PCLK/HCLK)
Bare core CF_UART asynchronous active-low reset
Wishbone classic slave (CF_UART_WB wrapper). clk_i clock, rst_i synchronous active-high reset, 32-bit adr_i/dat_i/dat_o, 4-bit sel_i, cyc_i/stb_i/we_i, ack_o.
APB slave (CF_UART_APB wrapper). PCLK clock, PRESETn active-low reset, 32-bit PADDR/PWDATA/PRDATA, PSEL/PENABLE/PWRITE/PREADY.
AHB-Lite slave (CF_UART_AHBL wrapper). HCLK clock, HRESETn active-low reset, 32-bit HADDR/HWDATA/HRDATA, HTRANS/HSEL/HREADY/HREADYOUT.
Aggregated interrupt output (uppercase IRQ on all WB/APB/AHB-Lite wrappers)

parameters.name: MDW
parameters.description: Maximum UART data size/width (data path width).

parameters.name: SC
parameters.description: Number of RX oversampling samples per bit (UART_RX/UART_TX NUM_SAMPLES).
